# Innovation & Technology

> MENASCO is investing in proprietary technologies, artificial intelligence, enterprise data systems, automation, and digital engineering platforms to improve project delivery, operational efficiency, compliance, quality, and decision-making across the organization.

## Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS)

ATLAS is a MENASCO pilot project focussed on AI-powered compliance. The platform is being designed to evaluate engineering designs against applicable codes, standards, and regulatory frameworks to improve readiness for review before submission. From mission-critical facilities to hospitality and residential developments; ATLAS ensures we do it right the first time, every time.

## LYNX

LYNX is MENASCO's intelligent field quality management platform, built to make identifying, assigning, and resolving construction issues faster and more transparent. Using photos, voice notes, and AI-assisted issue recognition, LYNX captures critical site information and routes it to the right teams for action. From initial observation through verification and closure, every issue is tracked in one auditable workflow, improving accountability, visibility, and quality across projects.

- [Privacy Policy](https://menascogroup.com/lynxqc/privacy-policy/llms.txt)

## AI Engineering

Using AI across engineering, quantity takeoffs, recruitment, payroll management and tenders, MENASCO has increased its workforce efficiency by 30%. That time has freed our teams to take on larger projects, more of them, and to train and upskill for more impactful work.

## MENASCO Connect

MENASCO Connect is our proprietary workforce management platform, integrating recruitment, manpower planning, site attendance, leave management, employee assessments, and internal communications into a unified digital environment. By connecting workforce forecasts with real-time deployment and personnel data, the platform streamlines administrative processes, improves resource allocation, and strengthens workforce visibility across the organization.

## Engineering Tomorrow

MENASCO believes the future of engineering lies in combining decades of construction expertise with intelligent technologies that improve quality, efficiency, sustainability, compliance, and project certainty. Technology is not replacing engineering: it is empowering our engineers to deliver better outcomes for clients and projects.
